title: Senator Rayencourt
description: In the age of the High Republic, Senator Rayencourt had his doubts about the nobility of the Jedi Order and the abilities of whether its individual members could truly keep their emotions in check. Rayencourt was a suspicious representative who lacked faith in the very organization that others saw as heroes. When rumors of a Jedi murder investigation reached him, Rayencourt went directly to Jedi Master Vernestra Rwoh for answers.
